abstract: A 56-year-old man presented with a painless mass in the left scrotum. The mass was first noticed when he was a junior high school student,and it had been left for about 40 years. The intrascrotal tumor of 7 cm in diameter was elastic soft and smooth. The serum levels of α -fetoprotein, β -human chorionic gonadotropin and lactate dehydrogenase were within each individual normal range. He was diagnosed as having a left testicular tumor (cT1N0M0) and underwent left high orchiectomy. Histopathological diagnosis was mature teratoma without any malignant germ cell components. No evidence of recurrence has been observed for 4 years after the operation.
abstract_ja: 56歳の男性が左陰嚢内の無痛性腫瘤を主訴に受診した。この腫瘤は中学生時代に初めて気づいたもので、約40年間放置されていた。陰嚢内腫瘤は直径7cmで、弾性軟かつ平滑であった。血清のAFP、β-ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、LDHはいずれも各個人の基準値内であった。左精巣腫瘍（cT1N0M0）と診断され、左高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的診断は悪性胚細胞成分を含まない成熟奇形腫であった。術後4年間、再発は認められていない。
